author: Seung Wook
problem: A regional fair had last_year visitors last year and this_year visitors this year (last_year > 0). Return the percentage change in attendance from last year to this year, rounded to one decimal place.
bug_description: Divides the change by this_year instead of last_year, so the percentage is measured against the wrong year.

comments.accurate: Percentage change in attendance from last year to this year
comments.wrong_behavior: Percentage change in attendance, as a share of this year's crowd
comments.wrong_location: Percentage formula verified; check the rounding keeps one decimal place
